source: Real browser screens from the capstone C server with separate fictional demo data

frames.label: Start with an empty library dashboard
Open Add book
Enter the first book title and author
Save the book to the C server
Enter a second book
Second book saved
Browse the saved collection
Search for Clean Code
Search narrows the collection
Open member registration
Register a demonstration member
Member saved to the directory
Register a second member for the reservation example
Two registered members
Open the checkout workflow
Choose a copy, member, and 14-day loan period
Checkout confirmed by the C server
Review the active loan and its due date
Renew the active loan and extend its due date
Open reservations while the copy is on loan
Reserve the borrowed copy for Sam Demo
The reservation is now pending in the queue
Renewal is blocked because another member is waiting
Return the book; it becomes reserved for the waiting member
The returned copy is reserved for Sam Demo
Select Sam Demo for the reserved copy
Checkout to the waiting member succeeds
Both returned loans remain in the circulation history
The reservation is marked fulfilled
Open stock management
Receive two physical copies in one transaction
Stock totals update to four copies
Mark one demo copy as damaged
Save the damaged status for copy 3
Filter the stock list to damaged copies
Removed copies remain in the record
Restore the demo copy to active stock
Dashboard reflects four available copies and completed circulation
